description:
The Huffy Malmö Conversion Trike is made to support your child’s early riding journey. Starting as a parent-steered trike, it gradually transitions as kids gain confidence and coordination.
An adjustable parent steering handle allows adults to guide direction and speed, making rides safer and more enjoyable. A built-in parent cup holder keeps drinks close at hand during walks and rides.
A padded seat with supportive backrest, built-in footrests, and a secure safety harness help keep little riders comfortable. The removable canopy adds sun protection when needed and can be taken off as your child grows.
With a durable steel frame, rear storage bin, and thoughtful parent-friendly features, the Malmö is built for daily use. It’s a practical, reassuring choice for trips around the neighborhood or park.
